name: Moving block behind the freight train, ETCS level 2
description: The Valle Lauro line with ETCS Level 2 and the moving block: the movement authority of the regional train ends 50 m behind the confirmed rear end the freight train ahead reports every 6 s, not at the signal before its block section. Compared with the same run at fixed block (the scenario without `spacing`), the regional train follows closer and arrives earlier.
